ruleDefinitions.name: New Cron Job Addition Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: This rule detects attempts to add a new cron job. This could be indicative of an attacker trying to establish persistence by scheduling tasks.

sequences.query: (process_command_line:"crontab " AND process_command_line:("-e","-l")) OR (process_command_line:"echo " AND process_command_line:("| crontab -"))
